content: You will be given an argumentation and asked about to find the relation from relation types: sup (support), exa (support by example), add (additional source), reb (rebutting attack), und (undercutting attack), joint (joining relation) between two selected argument components from it.

The universities in Germany should not under any circumstances charge tuition fees. This would impede or prevent access to those who are financially weaker. The anticipated objectives of tuition fees can be achieved by other means. There are other instruments to motivate tighter discipline while studying. And funding-wise it ought to be considered how costs incurred by students from other (federal) states can be reimbursed.
What is the relation between "This would impede or prevent access to those who are financially weaker." and "There are other instruments to motivate tighter discipline while studying." from the above essay? Choose from following options 1. reb
2. und
3. joint
4. exa
5. sup
6. no relation
